items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: One of my closest friends, Jimmy Rowles, was an alcoholic and we traveled with Peggy

ctx.x: You remained pretty healthy. Not so with some of the musicians.

You know there was a time when dissipation was the thing, unfortunately, you know the drug scene or getting strung out. Well it’s like when people used to booze, you know, liked to take drinks. Later on, I’m talking about 45, 50 years ago, nobody thought anything about drinking. But then they found out about this thing called alcoholism, you know, and then later, Alcoholics Anonymous and things like that, because it’s a real sickness in a sense. You know if it’s in the genes prior, that it can be very — and I…
What has your experience been overseas?
